verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration collects extensive personal data through its online applications and ID Check app, so asking whether applicants can keep that data out of AI training is a fair privacy question. The axis therefore applies, and this is not a category error. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy or opt-out; the only privacy-related item covers seeing the personal information UKVI holds about you, which is not a training opt-out.
